SCARLETT's hands only enter the frame — fingertips and the edge of her wrist with a thin elastic hair tie on it, sleeves of her pale kiosk uniform polo just visible at the top corner, cropped tight. Her fingers are caught mid-motion peeling back a curl of cream tissue paper inside a torn cardboard mailer, the other hand lifting the lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK) free of its tissue bed, thumb poised against the cap with the twist just beginning, condensation-bright specular light licking the metal band, the tube angled slightly toward camera and sharply in focus while the tissue behind it falls into creamy bokeh. Beneath it, a folding table surface jammed against a white square-tiled wall, laminate edge glowing, crumpled cream tissue and shredded packing tape scattered around, a folded white towel just out of focus at the frame edge, blurred dryer and clipped circular ring light throwing a soft round catchlight across the glossy surfaces. Hard directional morning sunlight through aluminium louvre slats slices crisp parallel stripes of gold across white cardboard and tile, high-key and airy with lifted shadows, whites crisp, warmth in the highlights, one accent of saturated coral popping against the neutral base.
